[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Wesley was born in 1842. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1969|William Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-571955|Eliza Unknown]].  He passed away in 1886. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1969]] is assessed at 97% (proved). William's retained 1888 county-biography family table explicitly includes Wesley Clark among William and Eliza's four children. His 1842 birth agrees with their recorded migration year and uniquely identifies this son.

Selected Glasgow-1969 fatherhood of Glasgow-1971; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare full 1879 p 263 with Wesley's 1886 death entry.
